beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: For the alternative entrance, let the book's own note establish the terms.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The Museum of Good Reasons suits readers drawn to unsettling philosophical fiction.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its distinctive pleasure is a place whose objects argue through their histories.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Begin with the lamp, then follow what each official description cannot contain.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Notice when a helpful distinction becomes a way to end attention.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Listen when a person refuses the role another observer wants to assign.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book gives those refusals room to change the investigation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its invitation is to understand more without making someone's loss conveniently disappear.
